stories.headline: COP31 runs into overtime with no deal
stories.summary: Talks pass the Friday deadline; a third draft is due Saturday morning with fossil-fuel language stripped and the $120bn adaptation target dropped.

stories.headline: Three missiles downed over Riyadh
stories.summary: Saudi-led air defences destroy three Houthi ballistic missiles over the capital early Saturday, the third night of attacks.

stories.headline: M6.7 quake shakes Peru's Andes
stories.summary: USGS puts it at 6.7, 108 km deep, at 00:09 UTC; felt in Lima, no deaths or serious damage reported.

stories.headline: Russian strikes kill 12 in a day
stories.summary: A double-tap ballistic strike kills a boy of 7 and a paramedic and injures 42; the overnight barrage hits cities across Ukraine.

stories.headline: BepiColombo reaches Mercury after 8 years
stories.summary: The ESA–JAXA craft fires four thrusters for 37 minutes at 18:24 UTC to be caught by Mercury's gravity; two orbiters, science from April 2027.

stories.headline: Jet lands safely in Davao, all 146 safe
stories.summary: Air Niugini PX19 diverts after an engine-fire warning and lands ~00:08; all 137 passengers and 9 crew safe, evacuated by slides.

stories.headline: Rutte flies to Warsaw as Poland seeks NATO cover
stories.summary: NATO's chief visits on Saturday after Friday's missile landings in Poland; Warsaw asks for more eastern-flank support.

stories.headline: 700,000 flee clashes in southern Ethiopia
stories.summary: Islamic Relief says Oromo–Somali fighting around Moyale has displaced ~700,000; 50,000 fled into Kenya.

stories.headline: Boat capsizes in Nigeria, 4 dead
stories.summary: A funeral boat capsizes on the Nun River; police confirm 4 dead, 24 rescued; the search continued on Saturday.

stories.headline: Rahul's 124* puts India on top
stories.summary: Rahul unbeaten on 124 at tea as India reach 344/2, replying to New Zealand's 368 on day three.

stories.headline: Russell fastest in Las Vegas FP3
stories.summary: Russell clocks 1:34.041 as Mercedes lock out the front row; qualifying runs under the lights tonight.

stories.headline: Trump hails 'very good talks' with Putin
stories.summary: After the Shenzhen APEC meeting, the president says there is 'a real good chance' of a Ukraine deal; reported widely on Saturday.

stories.headline: Coalition hits Houthi workshops in Sanaa
stories.summary: The coalition strikes six Houthi workshops in Sanaa and hits Hodeidah port after urging civilians to leave.

stories.headline: Denmark charges two over Russian murder plot
stories.summary: Two Danes are accused of being recruited by Russia to kill a Ukrainian rapper; police intercepted armed suspects.

stories.headline: Rare EU-UK summit as Burnham seeks to mend Brexit
stories.summary: Leaders meet in Brussels to repair post-Brexit ties.

stories.headline: Students march against rearmament and service
stories.summary: Students rally in Berlin against rearmament and mandatory service.

stories.headline: Youth march in ~400 cities for the future
stories.summary: The Youth Strike coalition rallies in 25+ countries, 'for our future, not their wars'.

stories.headline: Trump: Iran wants a deal
stories.summary: The president says Tehran seeks an agreement as Israel urges strikes.

stories.headline: Pipeline chief arrested over illicit oil trading
stories.summary: Iraq arrests a pipeline chief over accusations of illicit oil trading.

stories.headline: Iran claims waters 500 km beyond the strait
stories.summary: The IRGC claims waters 500 km beyond the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.headline: US clears ~900,000 AI chips for China
stories.summary: Washington approved the sale of close to 900,000 AI chips to China over six months.

stories.headline: Modi opens SCO dialogue forum
stories.summary: A three-day forum on culture and cooperation opens in Delhi.

stories.headline: Frosty APEC greeting for Takaichi
stories.summary: Beijing presses Tokyo on Taiwan at the APEC meeting.

stories.headline: China warns on climbing Mount Fuji
stories.summary: China warns its citizens on Fuji climbs; a missing climber's family offers a reward.

stories.headline: Myanmar, China call ICJ ruling 'unjust'
stories.summary: Both reject the court's first genocide verdict; Switzerland calls it an important step.

stories.headline: California subpoenas Nvidia
stories.summary: The attorney general probes the ex-CEO's exit and China ties; shares fell ~12%.

stories.headline: Jury convicts man who started deadly Palisades Fire
stories.summary: Jonathan Rinderknecht, 30, guilty on two federal counts; the 2025 fire killed 12.

stories.headline: Pentagon puts Iran engagement cost at $48.3bn
stories.summary: A Pentagon official puts the cost of US engagement against Iran at $48.3bn.

stories.headline: Second judge blocks Trump's triumphal arch
stories.summary: A second judge blocks the arch, calling it a 'rushed job'.

stories.headline: Caravan of about 300 migrants crosses into Mexico
stories.summary: A caravan of about 300 migrants crosses into Mexico.

stories.headline: Brazil advances Indigenous land bill
stories.summary: Brazil advances an Indigenous land bill as the leader meets Amazon chief Raoni.

stories.headline: ANC scrambles after worst result since 1994
stories.summary: The ANC takes 31% of the vote, down from 46% in 2021; DA 25%, MK 10%.

stories.headline: Wall Street enters correction
stories.summary: The S&P 500 falls 3.6% to 6,918, more than 10% below its 6 Oct record.

stories.headline: Bitcoin sinks below $56,000
stories.summary: Bitcoin falls ~9% in a day to its lowest since Sept 2024; $2.4bn in liquidations.

stories.headline: India launches first H5N1 vaccine
stories.summary: A home-made vaccine for chickens, the first of its kind.

stories.headline: Yearbook: only 44 of 96 climate indicators improving
stories.summary: The UN yearbook finds only 44 of 96 climate indicators improving.
